## cargoship dev render

Renders package definition templates into a distro.yaml and the files beside it

### Synopsis

Evaluates Go templates against one or more YAML values files and writes the result, which is how a fleet of package definitions that differ only in a version, an architecture or a CNI is kept as one template plus a small input file per package.

Each --template renders to its own base name with the '.tmpl' suffix dropped, so 'distro.yaml.tmpl' becomes 'distro.yaml' and 'values.yaml.tmpl' becomes 'values.yaml' in the --out directory. Every template renders against the same merged values, so a value that has to agree between a definition and the values beside it is written once.

The values files are merged in the order given, later files winning, and reach a template as its top-level context: a file setting 'version: 1.36.4' is addressed as '{{ .version }}'. The template functions are the ones a package's own values templates get -- the sprig set, minus the functions that read host state -- so a template cannot read the environment or resolve names. A value path that resolves to nothing is an error rather than a 'no value' placeholder in the output.

An output named 'distro.yaml' is checked against the package schema before anything is written, so a definition that renders but cannot be built is reported here rather than by 'cargoship create'. Pass --no-validate to write it anyway.

This is the same generator cargoship's own example packages under example/ are rendered with, with one difference: the digest helpers those templates use fetch and hash remote artifacts, and are not available here.

```
cargoship dev render [flags]
```

### Examples

```

# Render a definition from a template and an input file
$ cargoship dev render --template ./distro.yaml.tmpl --values ./v1.36.4.yaml --out ./packages/v1.36.4

# Render a definition and the values file beside it together
$ cargoship dev render -t ./distro.yaml.tmpl -t ./values.yaml.tmpl -f ./common.yaml -f ./v1.36.4.yaml -o ./packages/v1.36.4

```

### Options

```
  -h, --help[=true|false]          help for render
      --no-validate[=true|false]   Write a rendered distro.yaml without checking it against the package schema first.
  -o, --out string                 Directory to write the rendered files to. Created if it does not exist. (default ".")
  -t, --template stringArray       Template to render, repeatable. Each one is written to the --out directory under its own name with '.tmpl' dropped.
  -f, --values stringArray         YAML file holding the values every template renders against, repeatable. Merged in the order given, later files winning.
```
